section_summary.extract_value: This section describes the cross-cultural adaptation and classroom administration procedure for the BAS among Brazilian young adolescents, including obtaining permission from original BAS authors, ethics approval, parental consent, and in-class paper administration. Anthropometric measures (weight/height) were taken individually by the main researcher to obtain BMI. The section does not label any study as 'Study 1' nor report sample size, demographic breakdowns, mean age, or correlations between body appreciation and BMI.
